datasets.publisher: Quandl community WIKI Prices, documented by Nasdaq Data Link
datasets.rights: Public domain dedication explicitly stated by feed publisher; not inferred from mirror code license
datasets.publisherRightsStatement: curated by the Quandl community and released into the public domain
datasets.transformation: Filter inclusive dates, sort ascending, retain original raw open/high/low/close decimal strings and integer volume; no price rescaling, interpolation or fabricated bars
datasets.priceBasis: Raw unadjusted OHLCV, USD per pre-2020-split share
datasets.corporateActions: Source ex_dividend=0 and split_ratio=1 for all 61 selected rows; no synthetic corporate actions in replay
datasets.gaps: US trading-session rows only; weekends and exchange holidays intentionally absent, no forward-generated candles
datasets.executionModel: Game-local 09:00-16:00 daily opening-reference price; no intraday path, order book or tick-volume reconstruction. Full daily OHLCV visible only after model close. Prices do not branch because of player trades.
datasets.coverageLimit: AAPL daily 61 sessions only; not an IDX dataset, real-time feed or intraday backtest
